name: Audiobook TTS
description: Audiobook-style TTS for your notes — reads markdown aloud via a local OpenAI-compatible TTS server (e.g. OpenVox). Select any sentence to hear it via a quick play button, with chunk prefetching for gapless full-note playback, a draggable toolbar, table/parens/code filters, and optional WAV export.
author: jang-hs
